comparison.objective: Snap a cable clip onto a robot arm link; candidate adjusts the robot gripper's opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Align and press a spring clip over a tube versus coaxial two-tool torque adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Clip centered at the painted band with jaws snapped and released versus locked angle retained through cycles.
comparison.reason: Shared robot-hardware context is insufficient; snap-fit installation and stop calibration are different abilities.
